m: Freeze the steak for 20 minutes so it slices thin. Slice across the grain into thin strips.
Marinade: soy, brown sugar, sesame oil, grated garlic and ginger, and the white parts of the spring onion. Toss the beef through and leave 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Rinse the rice and cook it: 1 cup rice to 1½ cups water, lid on, 12 minutes on low, then rest 10 minutes off the heat.
Quick pickles: slice the cucumber thin and toss with rice vinegar and a pinch each of salt and sugar.
Gochujang mayo: stir the gochujang into the mayo, loosen with a splash of water.
Get a pan or wok smoking hot. Cook the beef in small batches, 1 to 2 minutes each, so it chars rather than stews. Pour any leftover marinade in at the end and let it bubble sticky.
Build bowls: rice, beef, pickles and kimchi. Drizzle the mayo, finish with green spring onion and sesame seeds.
l: Pack the beef and rice together, with the pickles, kimchi and mayo in a separate container so nothing goes soggy.
g: Tamari instead of soy, and sriracha mayo instead of gochujang (most gochujang contains wheat). Kimchi usually is GF but check the label. Marinate the GF beef in its own bowl and cook it first.
